Task1 · Coherent drive

Eight NEW coherent3000/3030Hz drive compositions plus a CACHED exclusive-sine3k control;30Hz beat,4 physical pads,2 outputs/commonGND/50Ω. Both tones drive both outputs in the new rows. Same original4-square-pad geometry,2 independent outputs/common GND/50Ω; fixed D50mm and0.1/5/5/15mm layers. Values are precomputed, not recomputed by this page.

Primary ROI:r≤5mm,depth15–20mm. WholeXY at that depth is supplemental. All field tables/bars use V/m; burdens use A/m²,V RMS,W,mA. maxTIS is a2074-direction sampled maximum; fixedTIS uses(X+Y)/√2; RMS is not TIS modulation. Here both active sine carriers are included in RMS.

Calculated and unadopted. Existing SC/XY/bulk/contact convergence holds remain; no new C1 control, instrument-loaded prediction, experimental validation or safety certification. Skin/contact-only can exceed1Vpp numerically; legacy composite additionally caps source power and1Vpp. Current sum is output-RMS bookkeeping, not common-return current.

Previous result GUI (original scope) (unchanged). This screen contains shared-axis scalar bars. This viewer creates no physical maps; historical maps must retain their original drive definitions.

Actual source waveform and hardware scope

Raw1Vpp means the stored full two-tone source max-minus-min before50Ω, with conservative upper1Vpp and producer bracket≤1µV over1/30s. Skin8/equal-power/current comparisons can require actual source Vpp above1; they are not fixed-voltage results. The ordinary table shows upper bounds for coherent rows; the interval table retains both bounds. The historical square anchor retains its nominal stored source definition; no new waveform bracket is invented for it. Seed coefficients are unitary only before separate actual-Vpp normalization.

Signed ideal/metal powers retain negative values and passive-output absorption. Phase synchronization, source sink/compliance and actual multitone hardware remain unverified. Field and40 native-phi actual-waveform checks passed as stored producer evidence; no independent reconstruction occurs in this GUI. Probes remain UNLOADED; ETA loading/bandwidth/attenuation validation is held. No new C1 or physical field map is claimed.

Historical square RMS includes both fundamentals and both third harmonics. Coherent and cached pure-sine RMS include the two active fundamentals only; RMS is not modulation.

Stored canonical eight-gate screens

Fixed original-square skin_contact_only; selectors do not recompute verdicts. Cached sine has no new screen.
